name: Apple
does_well: One claim per scroll stop, never stacking multiple messages on one screen
Very large, confident display type paired with a short supporting sentence — no paragraphs on the first screen of a section
One large, carefully composed product image dominates each section rather than several small supporting images
Color is spent on the subject (the product itself), not on decorative UI chrome
applicable_pattern: Use this when a business has one genuinely strong product/photo per section to show — pace the page around revealing one thing at a time instead of a dense feature wall.
do_not: Copy Apple's exact typeface, exact gray/white values, or any of its copy. The pattern is pacing and restraint, not the specific visual identity.

name: Shopify
does_well: Alternating flat-color section backgrounds create scroll rhythm instead of a uniform gray page
Specific, concrete proof (real numbers, real examples) instead of abstract marketing claims
Approachable type scale — confident but warmer/friendlier than a purely premium-brand register
One clear, high-contrast CTA per section
applicable_pattern: Use this for small-business or approachable-commerce redesigns — section-by-section color changes plus concrete, specific proof rather than vague claims.
do_not: Copy Shopify's exact green, exact illustrations, or exact copy. The pattern is rhythm and specificity, not the visual identity.

name: Stripe
does_well: Shows the real product (interface, code, data) as the primary imagery instead of generic icons or stock photos
Reserves monospace specifically for genuinely technical content (code, data) rather than as generic label decoration
A signature visual device (when present) is applied consistently and sparingly, not as decoration slapped on every card
Maintains one clear hierarchy per section even at higher information density than a typical marketing site
applicable_pattern: Use this when the subject has a real interface, process, or technical output worth showing directly — the product itself is the strongest image available, stronger than any illustration.
do_not: Copy Stripe's gradient mesh, exact colors, or copy. The pattern is 'the real thing is the image,' not the specific visual identity.

name: Land-book (gallery pattern, not a single site)
does_well: Curates landing pages where type scale alone often carries most of the visual weight
Featured sites tend to commit to one unusual-but-legible layout idea rather than a safe default grid
Sparse, deliberate motion — one or two signature moments rather than constant animation
applicable_pattern: When choosing a direction, favor one distinctive composition idea over a safe default, and prefer oversized confident type over decorative elements to create visual interest.
do_not: This is a general pattern observed across many rotating gallery entries, not a description of any single specific site. Never copy a specific featured site's exact layout, copy, or imagery.

name: Awwwards (gallery pattern, not a single site)
does_well: Award-recognized sites usually show real, specific project imagery rather than generic stock photography
Each section typically has a genuinely different composition from its neighbor, avoiding a repeated card-grid pattern
Color and type decisions tend to serve one coherent idea across the whole page rather than varying section to section without reason
applicable_pattern: Vary section layouts deliberately rather than repeating one card-grid pattern throughout the page, and favor real specific imagery over generic stock whenever it's available.
do_not: This is a general pattern observed across many rotating gallery entries, not a description of any single specific site. Never copy a specific featured site's exact layout, copy, or imagery.
